configsets.name: entities
configsets.note: Main archive collection — contains all AMČR record types (dokument, akce, lokalita, projekt, samostatný nález, ADB, 3D model). The schema has 330+ explicit fields + 25 dynamic. Priority collection.

configsets.name: work
configsets.note: Session/working storage. Only 4 fields: id, type, data, expiration. Minimalist schema for temporary data.

configsets.name: heslar
configsets.note: Controlled vocabulary/heslář. Key fields: ident_cely, nazev_heslare, razeni, hierarchie_vyse, hierarchie_nize, is_deleted. Wildcard dynamic field *→string. Copyfield * → text_all (lowercase_cs).
problems: copyField source='*' dest='text_all' — copies ALL fields, including numeric and dates. Performance impact during indexing.

configsets.name: soubor
configsets.note: File metadata in the repository. Fields: path, stav, size_bytes, rozsah, vytvoreno, datestamp, text_all. Wildcard dynamic field *→string. Copyfield * → text_all.

configsets.name: oai
configsets.note: DIFFERENT file name: managed-schema.xml (the others have managed-schema without an extension). Collection for the OAI-PMH protocol. Key fields: ident_cely, datestamp, xml (stored not indexed), model, organizace, pristupnost, stav. Schema generated automatically by Solr (managed schema API).
problems: File managed-schema.xml (with the .xml extension) instead of managed-schema — different naming convention

configsets.name: deleted
configsets.note: Records of deleted objects. Minimal schema.

configsets.name: uzivatel
configsets.note: System users. Contains sensitive fields: email, telefon (indexed=true, stored=true).

field_types.name: rdate
field_types.note: PROBLEM: does not support docValues — cannot sort/facet

field_types.name: string_big
field_types.note: For large text data without length limits

stored_not_indexed_fields.note: indexed=false — cannot filter; f_typ_lokality is used for filtering

copy_fields.note: Fulltext fields text_all_A..E are populated programmatically in ArcheologickyZaznam.setFullText(), not via copyField

request_handlers.name: /search
request_handlers.note: Main search handler with extended parameters

record_types.note: Supertype for akce and lokalita, populates az_dj_*, az_dj_adb, az_dj_pian

indexing.trigger: Primarily FedoraHarvester.update(from, until) — incremental based on the 'modified' timestamp from the Fedora REST API. Full reindexing via FedoraHarvester.harvest() or FedoraHarvester.indexModels().
indexing.incremental_mechanism: Query: /fcr:search?condition=modified>={lastDate}. Timestamp stored in update_time.txt in CONFIG_DIR.
indexing.commit_strategy: commit() called after each batch, separately for 'oai', 'entities', and the other collections
indexing.client_instances: Two singleton Http2SolrClient instances: solrClient (write) and solrClientSearch (read), without timeout configuration

issues.title: Typo multiValued='fslse' in the entities schema
issues.description: The field samostatny_nalez_projekt has multiValued="fslse" (typo). Solr accepts the invalid value and behavior depends on the version.

issues.title: luceneMatchVersion 9.4 vs. solr-solrj 9.10.1
issues.description: All solrconfig.xml files have luceneMatchVersion=9.4, but the client library is 9.10.1. New Lucene optimizations are not activated.
issues.fix: Update luceneMatchVersion to the current Solr server version in all 14 solrconfig.xml files

issues.title: BoolField without docValues — slower filtering
issues.description: The BoolField type has no docValues=true. Boolean fields (is_deleted, searchable, akce_je_nz) are heavily filtered in SearchUtils.java, LogAnalytics.java, ImageServlet.java. Without docValues, access is via FieldCache.
issues.fix: Add docValues=true to BoolField in managed-schema

issues.title: FedoraHarvester.indexModels() — max_results=10,000,000 without pagination
issues.description: Potentially loads the entire repository into a JSONObject in memory. Risk of OutOfMemoryError.

issues.title: SolrSearcher.getAllKatastry() — setRows(100000) without overflow verification
issues.description: Silent truncation with >100000 cadastres. The entire HashMap in memory without TTL.
issues.fix: Verify numFound <= rows; add a cursor or explicit limit with logging

issues.title: rdate (DateRangeField) without docValues — cannot sort/facet
issues.description: The fields projekt_datum_zahajeni, projekt_datum_ukonceni, projekt_datum_provedeni are rdate. DateRangeField does not support docValues.
issues.fix: For sort/facet add duplicate pdate fields; keep rdate for range queries

issues.title: az_dj_nazev: commented out in the schema (type=string) vs. active field (type=text_general)
issues.description: Suggests incomplete refactoring — a commented-out string field and an active text_general field.
issues.fix: Remove the commented-out fragment; document the type change

issues.title: OAI collection — managed-schema.xml (with extension) vs. managed-schema (without extension)
issues.description: Different naming convention. Solr 9 managed schema mode prefers a file without an extension.

issues.title: Multiple setRows(10000) queries without pagination
issues.description: Results loaded into memory as a JSONArray. With a larger database: memory problems and slow response.
issues.fix: Implement cursor-based iteration or explicit pagination

issues.title: copyField source='*' in the heslar and soubor collections
issues.description: Copies numeric fields and dates into the fulltext field text_all as well. Unnecessary data duplication in the index.
issues.fix: Explicit list of source fields for copyField

issues.title: Sensitive fields email and telefon stored as plaintext in the uzivatel collection
issues.description: The email and telefon fields are indexed=true, stored=true. Access to the Solr admin interface allows extraction of all contacts.
issues.fix: Restrict access to the uzivatel collection; consider field-level security
